note: Owner's rules from 18 Nov 2026. Loss limit: a close 20% or more below average cost makes a holding a loser (early warning at 10%). Trailing: once a holding's peak close was 20% or more above cost, a close 15% or more below that peak flags it for a sell-part review. Applies to all holdings, including the six old losers. Before calling a flag, check volume, dividend dates and whether the close is live or official. Selling fees about 1.8-2%; buying back costs about the same, so a buy-back needs a fall of more than about 4%.
early_warning_note: Traffic light, added 18 Nov at the owner's request. red = a rule fired; amber = a tolerance signal (-10% on cost, 10% from peak when trailing is active, or within 5% of the trigger) plus at least one general sign (fall on 2x volume in the last 5 days, close below the 20-day average, a -9% day in the last 10, 3 falls in a row); watch = tolerance signal only; note = general sign only; green = none.
take_profit_note: Added 18 Nov at the owner's request (sell into strength). Targets: at +50% sell 25% of the holding, at +100% another 25%. Recover cost: once up 100%, sell enough units to get back everything paid and keep the rest. Size cap: no holding above 15% of the portfolio. Sells recorded in transactions.json after 18 Nov count as targets taken / cost returned.
peak_note: Set 18 Nov 2026 (owner accepted the recommendation): a peak counts only from the purchase date (a holding's bought_from in holdings.json), or from 1 Jan 2026 when the purchase date is not known. Peaks are reduced by dividends and adjusted for share reconstructions after them (corporate_actions.json). Rules use the combined holding across accounts; each account's units and cost are shown next to the flags.
liquidity_note: Thin-market check, added 24 Nov 2026 (owner chose all four). Realistic price: when a close is unchanged 5+ days and the 5-day trade-weighted price (value/volume) is 3%+ below it, or a block (5x median volume) in the last 10 days traded 5%+ below the close, gains, targets, trailing and size cap use that lower price. Fee check: targets and cost recovery count only if the realistic price is still a gain after ~2% fees. Sellable size: about 20% of median daily volume a day; bigger sales are spread over days.
horizons_note: Set 24 Nov 2026 by the owner. Each lot's horizon is in holdings.json. Short term: at +30% sell half; trail the rest 10% from the peak; earnings stop (latest EPS below the same period a year earlier: exit the rest); time stop (no new high in 8 weeks: review). Long term: no trailing while EPS is rising; thesis check when EPS fell in the last 2 reports (then the 15% trail applies; consider moving to short term); trim 25% above 25x trailing earnings; size cap 15%; recover cost at +100% kept. Untagged holdings keep the 18 Nov rules (+50%/+100% targets, 15% trail). Loss limit 20% applies to all.
